the I/sub c/(B) curves of swaged samples are shifted upwards compared to those of bare samples.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the SS tube swaging is an efficient method to introduce a compressive pre-strained state in the strand and the I/sub c/(B) measurements are not affected by the SS tube.
the I/sub c/, measured on the swaged sample, is higher than on the sample without swaged tube, but lower than on the sample with glue.

The main takeaway from our work is that
swaging the SS tube on the Nb/sub 3/sn strand does not introduce any additional strain, but it does reduce the I/sub c/.
the swaged SS-tube method is a simple, effective way to introduce compressive pre-strains in Nb/sub 2/Sn PIT strand samples.
